work_items.title: Provide the Decision Protocol v1 interface
work_items.goal: Make the decision product invocable as a technology-neutral black box.
obligations: The product can be invoked through its `product.toml` manifest.
It accepts one UTF-8 JSON Decision Request on standard input.
It returns one UTF-8 JSON Decision Result on standard output.
sources: Decision Protocol v1: manifest-driven process and JSON transport
Decision Contract `https://arturmiller.github.io/spec-compiler/resources/funding/kfw-458/#ApplicantEligibilityDecision`
excluded: A particular implementation language or framework
HTTP or a conversational user interface

work_items.title: Select the Rule Set Version by Decision Date
work_items.goal: Reproduce decisions in their declared temporal context without a current-date or latest-version default.
obligations: The Decision Request identifies the stable Rule Set and an explicit ISO Decision Date.
Exactly one Rule Set Version is selected from authored half-open validity intervals.
Every Decision Result reports the selected Rule Set Version and Decision Date.
Missing dates, uncovered dates, caller-selected versions, and overlapping validity intervals fail with actionable diagnostics.
Identical facts produce the two source-backed historical outcomes declared by the Version Selection Cases.
sources: `specs/`: Rule Set Versions, validity intervals, and version Source Citations
`specs/`: paired Version Selection Cases
Version Selection Conventions v1: date-only, exactly-one applicability
excluded: A silent current-date or latest-version default
Caller control over the selected Rule Set Version

work_items.title: Evaluate the declared decision contract
work_items.goal: Return the declared outcome for each explicit Conformance Case.
obligations: All declared Conditions are evaluated as satisfied, violated, or unknown.
A violated required Rule yields the declared negative outcome.
A Fact Gap without a violated Rule yields the declared unknown outcome.
Only all satisfied Rules yield the declared positive outcome.
The positive, negative, and unknown Conformance Cases pass end to end.
sources: Decision Contract `https://arturmiller.github.io/spec-compiler/resources/funding/kfw-458/#ApplicantEligibilityDecision`
`specs/`: Rules, Conditions, expected values, outcomes, and conformance Cases
Decision Conventions v1: explicit requires-all aggregation
excluded: Domain requirements not stated in the authored specs
An implementation technology inferred from domain vocabulary

work_items.title: Explain the decision with source provenance
work_items.goal: Expose decisive Rules, source statements, and Fact Gaps in every result.
obligations: Every decisive Rule identifies its Source Citation and Source Revision.
Every cited source statement and locator is present in the Decision Result.
Unknown results identify the exact missing Facts.
Every result contains a human-readable explanation and the scope note.
sources: `specs/`: Rule-to-Source Citation relations and source statements
`specs/`: scope note
Decision Conventions v1: decisive Rule and Fact Gap projection
excluded: A claim that the authored Spec completely transcribes the external source

work_items.title: Ask the next decision-relevant Fact Question
work_items.goal: Advance an unknown Case through source-backed questions to a determinate outcome.
obligations: Only a Fact Gap that currently prevents a unique outcome can produce the next question.
The lowest-priority unresolved authored Fact Question is selected deterministically.
The question identifies its Condition, input pointer, and supporting Rule and Source Citation.
Submitting each authored answer advances to the next justified question or a final outcome.
A determinate outcome never includes a next question.
sources: `specs/`: Fact Questions, priorities, Conditions, and Question Flow Case
Question Selection Conventions v1: select the lowest-priority current Fact Gap
Decision Conventions v1: violated Conditions make the outcome determinate
excluded: Questions unrelated to a Rule Condition
Session state, a conversational user interface, or adaptive question optimization

work_items.title: Evaluate Evidence Requirements separately from Conditions
work_items.goal: Report whether each applicable Evidence Requirement is fulfilled without changing the underlying Decision Outcome.
obligations: Each Evidence Requirement is evaluated as fulfilled, missing, or not_applicable.
A satisfied Rule Condition remains separate from fulfillment of its Evidence Requirement.
Supplied Evidence is classified as accepted, rejected, unassessed, or not_relevant for each Evidence Requirement.
Only matching Evidence with an explicit accepted Evidence Assessment fulfills a Requirement.
Each Evidence Requirement evaluation exposes its independent Source Citation and explanation.
The fulfilled, missing, and not-applicable conformance Cases pass end to end.
sources: `specs/`: Evidence Requirements, applicability Conditions, Evidence, Assessments, expectations, and Source Citations
Evidence Evaluation Conventions v1: all-condition applicability and explicit-assessment fulfillment
Decision Conventions v1: Evidence evaluation does not affect Rule Condition truth or Decision Outcome
excluded: Document file formats, upload protocols, or storage

work_items.title: Expose the Decision Contract over HTTP
work_items.goal: Accept Decision Requests from an HTTP client and return the same sourced Decision Results.
obligations: POST `/eligibility-decisions` accepts `application/json` according to the authored request schema.
The request body at JSON Pointer `` is the invoked contract input.
HTTP 200 returns `application/json` with the Decision Result at JSON Pointer `` according to the authored response schema.
Invalid requests return HTTP 400 with `application/json` and error text at JSON Pointer `/error` according to the authored error schema.
The product publishes an OpenAPI 3.1 document compatible with the generated HTTP contract.
sources: POST endpoint `https://arturmiller.github.io/spec-compiler/resources/funding/kfw-458/#ApplicantEligibilityPostEndpoint` and sco:invokesContract in the product specs
Request `https://arturmiller.github.io/spec-compiler/resources/funding/kfw-458/#EligibilityHttpRequest`: body schema, media type, requirement, and input pointer
Success response `https://arturmiller.github.io/spec-compiler/resources/funding/kfw-458/#EligibilityHttpResult`: body schema, media type, status, and result pointer
Invalid-request response `https://arturmiller.github.io/spec-compiler/resources/funding/kfw-458/#EligibilityHttpError`: body schema, media type, status, and error pointer
Decision Contract `https://arturmiller.github.io/spec-compiler/resources/funding/kfw-458/#ApplicantEligibilityDecision`
HTTP Contract Conventions v1: explicit JSON message schemas and body-pointer bindings
excluded: A particular web framework or implementation language
A user interface, session store, or funding calculation
